title.narrative: Reducing Irregular Migration from Albania to the UK, by providing alternative pathways to Albanian youth

description.narrative: SO1: Build the skills of teachers and educators in the lower middle and upper middle schools in Northern Albania to engage with young people directly and support them in building skills in subjects offering alternative opportunities. SO2: Enhance collaboration and build trust between young people and local media through enabling the engagement of local media/journalists with young people, their families and communities; build the skills of young people and educators/teachers to address and advocate jointly on local issues and challenges they care about and to create locally relevant stories and narratives, including raising awareness of the dangers of illegal migration, and the benefits of regular migration. SO3: Enable and empower local and grassroot organisations and informal groups to directly engage young people in identifying pressure points and problems, and create, plan and implement creative solutions which contribute to positive change.

The project aims to support deterring young people (aged 13-18) from migrating illegally to the UK by strengthening local communities and providing alternative opportunities for a better future in Albania through active engagement, awareness raising, skills development, and building trust and community cohesion.
Young people aged 13-18 from Kukes, Dibra and Shkodra
